i18n.zhSummary: 麻省理工学院的研究人员证实，基于克劳德的人工智能代理可以在虚拟荒岛上自行创建和探索游戏和挑战，并根据该经验提高执行后续任务的能力。当人工智能独自一人时，人工智能会做什么？ 《当我们把克劳德送到虚拟荒岛时发生了什么》首次出现在《麻省理工科技评论》上 |麻省理工学院技术评论韩国。
i18n.enTitle: What will AI do when left alone? What happened when we sent Claude to a virtual desert island?
i18n.enSummary: MIT researchers confirmed that Claude-based AI agents can create and explore games and challenges on their own on a virtual desert island, and improve their ability to perform subsequent tasks based on that experience. The post What will AI do when left alone? What Happened When We Sent Claude to a Virtual Desert Island appeared first on MIT Technology Review | MIT Technology Review Korea.

items.title: 복제하고 냉동 보존하는 시대…반려동물의 죽음과 애도의 의미
items.summary: 수명 연장 약물부터 복제와 냉동 보존까지 반려동물과의 이별을 미루려는 기술이 발전하고 있지만 죽음과 상실을 받아들이는 일의 의미도 돌아볼 필요가 있다. The post 복제하고 냉동 보존하는 시대…반려동물의 죽음과 애도의 의미 appeared first on MIT 테크놀로지 리뷰 | MIT Technology Review Korea .

i18n.zhTitle: 克隆和冷冻保存时代……宠物的死亡和哀悼的意义
i18n.zhSummary: 尽管技术不断进步，从延长生命的药物到克隆和冷冻保存，可以推迟与宠物的分离，但我们也需要反思接受死亡和失去的意义。克隆和冷冻保存时代……伴侣动物的死亡和哀悼的意义首先出现在《麻省理工科技评论》上麻省理工学院技术评论韩国。
i18n.enTitle: The era of cloning and cryopreservation... The death of a pet and the meaning of mourning
i18n.enSummary: Although technology is advancing to delay separation from pets, from life-extending drugs to cloning and cryopreservation, we also need to reflect on the meaning of accepting death and loss. The post The era of cloning and cryopreservation... Death of a companion animal and the meaning of mourning appeared first on MIT Technology Review | MIT Technology Review Korea.
